text: So the Guild finally sent me someone. Welcome to the Emoria Watch, warrior.
This outpost guards the Hollow March, and lately the March has not been quiet.
Gyria have been seen in the eastern woods. Before you go near them, you'll want a ring creature at your side.

choices.text: Where do I get a ring?

text: The Emoria Guild is older than any crown in Velicia. We swear to no king - only to the land and all who live on it.
Humans, Amir, Burrok, Vapouriun, Gouran... and yes, even the Gyria, when they keep the peace.
Master Oddrin, our ring-sage, will give you your first ring. He's the short one with the very long beard. Don't mention either.
Oddrin first, then the Hollow Road north. A scout of ours, Vel, is watching the woods.
You're back - and in one piece. Vorga's band broken? Then the March can breathe again.
You did the Guild proud today. Take this - a silver ring, and your pay.
And the Gyria scout... you freed her. Hm. The Guild serves all peoples - even Gyria. Let's hope she remembers the kindness.
else_text: And the Gyria scout stays with us for now. She'll be fed and heard. The Guild doesn't keep cages for long.

text: Something drove Vorga's clan south. The Pale Withering, she called it. That's a trail for another day.
(End of this chapter of the prototype. Explore, bind creatures, and train them!)
The March is quieter thanks to you. Keep your rings close, warrior.
